text_block_list.text: The day before tryouts...
Whew...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Ahh, that crisp acceleration! Нарита Брайан's
raw talent truly is
impossible to ignore.
text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
She's still rough around the edges, but
that just means she has endless
potential.
I'm looking forward to her performance
during tryouts
tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B

text_block_list.text:
Figures... The real race isn't even 'til
tomorrow, but she's already
snagged the
spotlight. Oh well, that just gets me even
more fired up!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Hishiama...
text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Oh... Were you watching Brian too?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
She really is on a whole other level. Are
you serious about going
one-on-one with
her?
text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Dead serious. You should definitely come
check it out. It'll be a race
to remember!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hishiama... Why do you even care about
some nobody like me?
text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Someday you're gonna have what it takes to toughen me up—so I can't just let you walk away. That's all there is to it.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
On that note... Hey, Trainer! Quit staring
at Brian and help me get
some last-minute
practice in! What's on the docket for
today?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Brian is undeniably a formidable
opponent, but there's no doubt that

Amazon's skills are evolving as well.

Thanks to her instincts and natural
learning ability, our sessions yield
results
day by day, fostering her continued
improvement.

After wrapping up our training, the big
day arrives.

The last race of today's tryouts will be
commencing shortly! All eyes
are on Narita
Brian, whose talents have won her high
acclaim!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume have all gathered at the
starting gates. Let the
2,000-meter turf
race... begin!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан falls from fourth to fifth place,
seemingly unconcerned by
the widening
gap in front of her! It's like she's out for a
morning jog,
folks!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Her movements are being carefully
scrutinized by Хиши Амадзон in
seventh
place! And with that, they're through the
first lap!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Hishiama...
text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Halfway through the race, Brian makes an
early move and advances
into third place.

Then, as the runners round the fourth
corner...
I'll tear this track up!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
And there goes Нарита Брайан! Brian takes
the lead! She's ahead of the
pack by
three—now four lengths!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Hah, I don't think so. Time for a
one-on-one!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон is closing in from the
outside! She's holding her own
against
Brian with her powerful stride!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Took you long enough. But don't get
cocky!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
With a fearsome burst of speed, Narita
Brian increases her pace even
further! She
tries to give Amazon the slip, but—
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Brian can't shake her off! Amazon
accelerates too! A fierce battle is

unfolding before our eyes right here on
the final straight!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: H-Hishiama!
text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
("Impossible" my ass! "Over" my ass! No
matter how many times you
lose, it doesn't
mean a thing!)
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: (As long as you refuse to lose to yourself right up to the bitter end, the match is never over!)
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Ultimately, Amazon comes in a close
second, just shy of Brian.

But her powerful performance stirs the
hearts of the spectators,
earning her a
rousing round of applause.
Dammit, I lost! But still—
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Sniffle, sob... Hishiamaaa! Th... That... That was incredible!
text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
C'mon, there's no reason to blubber like
that. So? You still planning
on leaving the
school?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Forget I said anything about it! I'm so
pumped up, I'm going to start
training
again from square one!
text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
And someday... I'll be strong enough to go
one-on-one with you,
Hishiama!
text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Sure thing! I can't wait!
...Oh, huh?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ama. I enjoyed that. Let's do it again
sometime.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Hah! Next time I'll be the one to tear up your track. Don't say I didn't warn you, Brian!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Hmph.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Хиши Амадзон! I was really
impressed by that competitive
spirit you
displayed today. Please let me scout you!
text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Oh, about that... Sorry, but I've already
found myself a training
partner.
Ain't that
right, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Absolutely. That training regimen of yours
is part of the reason I was
able to go
one-on-one with Brian in the first place.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'm lookin' forward to even more
hot-blooded battles from here on
out,
Trainer... Hmm. Y'know, that sounds kinda
stuffy.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: I know! How 'bout "Teach"?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: Sounds like something out of an old movie...

text_block_list.text:
Like "Yeah, I dig it, Teach"? Hahaha, that's
not half bad! Definitely
got a more
friendly ring to it at least.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Now then... Who should I go one-on-one
with next, Teach?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
And so, my days together with the
ever-dynamic Amazon begin.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
